title: Welcome to the Narita Family
overview: Only-child Ito’s life changes overnight when her mom remarries—and she gains four new stepbrothers!

title: Lies Make Families
overview: Ito suggest Mom goes with Dad since they just got married. But Gen tells Ito to go as well and not come back?!

title: The Narita Family’s New Rule
overview: Ito's midterm scores are terrible, so Raku helps her study in secret because Gen can't find out!

title: Unable to Be Honest
overview: Gomez has run away, and during the search Gen gets hurt. Even then, he won't allow Ito to take care of him.

title: Shut Away Angel
overview: The whole family is together for a BBQ -- except the shut in, Shu. Can Ito finally get through to him?

title: Siblings’ Feelings
overview: Ito and Shu's party is facing their fiercest opponent yet. Can they overcome this challenge and break free?

title: My Younger Brother Is a Prince?
overview: It's summer, so the family goes to see Ito's friends. Back in school, Gen is forced to be a prince for a play?

title: What’ll Happen to the Cultural Festival?!
overview: Ito feels some way about Gen, but she’s not sure what exactly. Udagawa sees right through her and says it's...

title: The Birthday Present Bonus
overview: Ito realizes she has romantic feelings for Gen. Raku finds out, and Gen overhears them talking about it.

title: A Sign of Connection
overview: Shu has a cosplayer friend?! Shu wants to meet this friend at an IRL event, but can he muster the courage?

title: The Hiroshima Onomichi Steam Incident
overview: Ito and Gen end up sightseeing alone on the school trip, and then something unexpected occurs…?!

title: Let the Memories Fall
overview: It's Christmas and everyone is home! After a huge party, Ito learns this day is very special for the Naritas.
